nutanix-nc2-reservation-steady.title: Compare a reservation for steadily running nodes
nutanix-nc2-reservation-steady.body: These Nutanix bare-metal nodes are priced pay as you go and are expected to run for a year or longer. Microsoft publishes a saving of 36.27% with a one-year reservation and 57.7% with a three-year one; the reservation covers the Azure nodes only, not the Nutanix licence. Compare the reserved price in this estimate.

citation.source: Nutanix Cloud Clusters on Azure pricing
citation.quote: Save 36.27% with a one-year reservation, or 57.7% discount for 3 years.
